# P33 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

Rooms keep their plans from rivals who read their threads, and they reach into rivals' venues. Members switch to their own language or write in code, move the plan to private messages, plant members in a rival's chat and warn of a snitch in their own.
